title: Police seek owner of P1.92-M cyanide found in Sarangani

blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — Police are trying to identify those behind at least two tons of sodium cyanide, a highly poisonous chemical, worth P1.92 million, found in an abandoned truck in the coastal town of Maasim, Sarangani province. Maj. Herman Luna, chief of the Maasim Municipal Police Station, said the chemicals were packed in 32 sacks and loaded onto a 10-wheeler truck parked near Tubong Beach in Barangay Tinoto around 10:30 p.m. on Wednesday, Oct. 7.
